query:
WITH locked AS (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM execution_attempts
                    WHERE
                        id = $1
                        AND outcome IN ('DROPPED', 'STUCK', 'REVERTED')
                        AND retry_lock = false
                    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
                )
                UPDATE execution_attempts ea
                SET
                    retry_lock = true
                FROM locked
                WHERE ea.id = locked.id
                RETURNING
                    ea.id,
                    ea.chain_id,
                    ea.operator_wallet_id,
                    ea.tx_type as "tx_type: TxType",
                    ea.nonce_used,
                    ea.tx_value,
                    ea.tx_hash,
                    ea.gas_limit,
                    ea.used_gas,
                    ea.max_fee_per_gas,
                    ea.max_priority_fee,
                    ea.max_fee_per_blob_gas,
                    ea.outcome as "outcome: TxExecutionOutcome",
                    ea.error_object,
                    ea.retryable,
                    ea.created_at,
                    ea.updated_at
